en_title: Anthropic Boss Dario Amodei Reportedly Had a Dystopian Solution for Simulating a Fulfilling Life for People Who Lose Their Jobs to AI: Video Games
cn_title: 据报道，Anthropic负责人Dario Amodei曾提出反乌托邦式解决方案，让因AI失业的人模拟充实的生活：电子游戏
opus_summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Anthropic负责人Dario Amodei在OpenAI工作期间，曾提出电子游戏或可安抚因AI取代工作而失业的人群。报道引发网友愤怒和嘲讽，有人质疑失业者如何购买游戏。

paragraphs.en: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei reportedly once suggested that video games could be the solution to political strife caused by AI-fueled joblessness.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Anthropic负责人Dario Amodei曾提出，电子游戏可能是解决AI引发的失业所导致的政治冲突的办法。

paragraphs.en: In a profile of Anthropic’s Dario and Daniela Amodei from the Wall Street Journal , it is reported that when Dario Amodei worked at OpenAI from 2016 to 2020, he allegedly suggested video games could pacify the masses after AI took their jobs.
paragraphs.cn: 华尔街日报在一篇关于Anthropic的Dario和Daniela Amodei的人物报道中称，据说Dario Amodei于2016年至2020年在OpenAI工作期间曾提出，在AI夺走大众的工作后，电子游戏可以安抚他们。

paragraphs.en: Here’s the relevant section of the profile:
paragraphs.cn: 以下是该人物报道中的相关部分：

paragraphs.en: The anecdote suggests a foresight from Dario Amodei about the potential of AI to cause mass layoffs, but also a rather dystopian solution that would see jobless people content to live out their lives playing video games rather than kick up a stink about losing their livelihoods.
paragraphs.cn: 这则轶事表明，Dario Amodei预见到了AI可能导致大规模裁员，但也提出了一个相当反乌托邦式的解决方案：让失业者心满意足地靠玩电子游戏度过一生，而不是为失去生计大吵大闹。

paragraphs.en: While this section of the WSJ profile mentioned Amodei’s alleged thoughts on this issue from some time ago (potentially a decade ago), and he may have changed his mind since then, it’s interesting to consider his mindset in the context of growing concern around mass layoffs as companies turn to AI to replace human workers to save money and, they claim, boost productivity.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管华尔街日报这篇人物报道的这一部分提到的是据称Amodei在一段时间以前（可能是十年前）对这一问题的看法，而他的想法此后也可能已经改变，但在企业转而用AI取代人类员工以节省开支、并且据它们所称提高生产力，从而引发人们对大规模裁员日益担忧的背景下，思考他的想法很有意思。

paragraphs.en: Survey data from Pew Research Center published in September showed how ordinary people around the world are worried about the economic impact of AI. In 34 of 37 countries Pew Research Center surveyed earlier this year , people tend to believe AI will lead to fewer jobs rather than more jobs. And people are getting more worried about this over time. In the U.S., the share of people who believe AI will result in job loss over the next 20 years increased seven percentage points in two years.
paragraphs.cn: Pew Research Center于9月公布的调查数据显示了世界各地的普通人对AI经济影响的担忧。在Pew Research Center今年早些时候调查的37个国家中，有34个国家的人倾向于认为AI会导致就业岗位减少，而不是增加。而且，随着时间推移，人们对此越来越担忧。在美国，认为AI将在未来20年导致工作岗位流失的人所占比例在两年内上升了7个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The profile also has a delicious timing, coming as it does around the launch of GTA 6 , a game that you’d imagine Dario Amodei might have considered to be a video game "immersive enough" to pacify the jobless masses long term.
paragraphs.cn: 这篇人物报道发表的时机也很有意思，正值《GTA 6》推出前后。你可以想象，Dario Amodei或许会认为这款游戏「足够沉浸」，能够长期安抚失业大众。

paragraphs.en: Reaction online to the profile is, predictably, a mix of outrage and mockery, with some posting The Matrix and Ready Player One memes in response. "Unless we’d get paid for playing video games, I don’t see how that would work. Boredom isn’t the problem with joblessness," one person said. “How do people buy games if they don't have a job that pays them?” another wondered.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，网上对这篇人物报道的反应既有愤怒也有嘲讽，一些人发出了《黑客帝国》和《头号玩家》的表情包作为回应。一人说：「除非玩电子游戏能拿到报酬，否则我不明白这怎么行得通。失业的问题不在于无聊。」另一人则疑惑道：「如果人们没有一份能挣钱的工作，他们怎么买游戏？」

paragraphs.en: The answer from people who are convinced of our AI-powered future to that common retort is, as Elon Musk is fond of saying, abundance for all. Musk believes that AI will create a post-scarcity economy where goods and services have become so plentiful that labor and money become redundant. In such an economy, no-one would need a job, because, so the theory goes, everyone has all they could ever want at the push of a button — for free.
paragraphs.cn: 对于这种常见的反驳，坚信我们将迎来AI驱动的未来的人给出的答案是，正如Elon Musk喜欢说的那样，让所有人都享有充裕的物资。Musk认为，AI将创造一种后稀缺经济，在这种经济中，商品和服务变得极为充裕，以至于劳动和金钱都不再必要。在这样的经济中，没有人需要工作，因为按照这一理论，每个人只要按一下按钮，就能免费获得自己想要的一切。

paragraphs.en: In such an economy, could video games keep everyone occupied enough to prevent political strife? Could a game like GTA 6 keep you busy… forever?
paragraphs.cn: 在这样的经济中，电子游戏能让所有人忙得无暇参与政治冲突吗？像《GTA 6》这样的游戏能让你一直玩下去……永远吗？
